serves.evidence: Presents a single visual subject scaling up from deep distance to the center with no accompanying text.
Solo highlight moment requiring dramatic focus.
centered slow zoom-in from deep distance
serves.condition: when the zoom-in withholds the subject's identity until late in the reveal

serves.evidence: Rotates media cards along a looping three-dimensional carousel, bringing each item into central focus in turn.
Showcasing a collection, portfolio, or group of items in continuous motion
serves.condition: when the cards hold sourced footage of a claimed behaviour rather than data

serves.evidence: Presents multiple media items streaming along a spiral vortex path around central text.
Broader portfolio summary emphasizing variety or volume
serves.condition: when the cards hold sourced footage illustrating the claim

serves.evidence: Streams a sequence of media cards horizontally through 3D space, bringing each item into focal view in turn.
Catalog or feature review accompanied by a heading and secondary subheading
serves.condition: when the cards hold sourced footage of the claimed subject

serves.evidence: Displays a continuous spiral arrangement of media items orbiting a central text overlay.
Summary sequence highlighting large asset volume or variety
serves.condition: when the cards hold sourced footage supporting the claim

serves.evidence: Compares two subjects side by side across four sequential rows with centered numerical markers.
Side-by-side comparison of two options across four distinct criteria or steps.
serves.condition: when the rows state a rule or weighting rather than a scored comparison

serves.evidence: Presents ten comparative items arranged into five opposing pairs branching outward from central topic icons.
Compares two subjects side by side across multiple criteria using segmented discrete rating scales.
serves.condition: when each criterion is treated as an independent measure per entity

serves.evidence: Presents two comparison columns side by side, revealing matching text entries row by row in parallel.
Side-by-side translation, phrase matching, or direct text pair comparison.
serves.condition: when rows list independent claims rather than direct translations

serves.evidence: Compares two subjects across multiple labelled metrics using opposing horizontal bar charts with printed percentage values.
Statistical or percentage-based comparison across multiple metrics between two brands or concepts.
serves.condition: when one side's bar functions as the fixed benchmark for the other

serves.evidence: Displays four vertical fill bars with animated percentage readouts and text descriptions across a shared baseline.
Comparing four distinct metric percentages, categories, or performance indicators simultaneously.
serves.condition: when the four percentages are subsets of one named population

serves.evidence: Presents six quantities grouped into three paired clusters on a shared vertical scale.
Presenting a two-variable comparison across three defined categories, groups, or cohorts.
serves.condition: when the two bars per cluster represent an earlier and later state

serves.evidence: Comparing before-and-after or two-period metrics across four discrete categories or variables.
Plots positive and negative quantities along a shared baseline against a calibrated vertical axis.
Displays twelve sequential values on vertical bars rising within capsule tracks along a shared horizontal axis.
Listing five website analytics, funnel conversion stages, or ranked performance metrics.
Displays five horizontal bars that animate simultaneously to different lengths within fixed percentage tracks on a shared scale.
serves.condition: when the five bars represent five distinct named entities rather than one entity's metrics

serves.evidence: Displays ten sequential values along a shared vertical scale, comparing their magnitudes with animated vertical bars.
Fills a single horizontal bar toward completion alongside an animated percentage counter and supporting text labels.
Highlighting project completion, goal achievement, fund-raising target, or single key performance milestone.
Compares quantities across three distinct groups using multi-bar clusters plotted along a shared vertical scale.
Displays a continuous sequence of media panels along a curved tracking carousel at equal visual weight.
High-level montage or multi-topic overview introducing diverse subjects or media archives
serves.condition: when the panels hold sourced footage illustrating the claim
